Your refund will be issued within **5 business days** of the parcel reaching our warehouse. It goes back to your original payment method.

A few things to keep in mind:
- The 5 business days starts when the warehouse receives the parcel, not when you drop it off, so transit time comes first.
- For a change-of-mind return, the refund will be the item price minus the **$6.95** return fee (waived for Leafy Plus members).
- I don't have information on how long your bank or card provider takes to show the money once we've issued it, so I can't give a timeframe for that part.

Also, since your 30-day return window runs from delivery, please start the new return from "My Orders" soon and drop the parcel off within 7 days of getting the new label.

Is there anything else I can help with?
